# AWS Documentation

> > Comprehensive technical documentation for Amazon Web Services, covering IAM Access Analyzer API reference, policy generation, access control configuration, and resource analysis.

This documentation provides detailed API references for AWS IAM Access Analyzer, a service that helps identify resources shared with external entities and generates least-privilege policies from CloudTrail logs. The documentation covers data structures, operations, and configuration types for analyzing access to S3, DynamoDB, EBS, SNS, and IAM resources.

## Key Topics

- IAM Access Analyzer
- Policy Generation
- Access Control Configuration
- Resource Analysis
- CloudTrail Integration
- S3 Bucket Security
- Unused Access Detection
- Archive Rules
- Trust Policies
- ACL Management
- API Reference
- AWS SDK Integration
- ARN-based Resource Identification
- JSON Policy Paths
- Finding Recommendations

## Core API Operations

- [StartPolicyGeneration - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_StartPolicyGeneration.html): API operation to start IAM policy generation from CloudTrail logs
- [GetAnalyzedResource - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_GetAnalyzedResource.html): API operation to retrieve analyzed resource info by ARN
- [ListAnalyzedResources - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_ListAnalyzedResources.html): API operation to retrieve list of analyzed S3, IAM, SQS resources
- [GenerateFindingRecommendation - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_GenerateFindingRecommendation.html): API operation to create recommendations for unused permissions findings
- [DeleteArchiveRule - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteArchiveRule.html): API operation to delete archive rules in IAM Access Analyzer

## Analyzer and Job Management

- [AnalyzerSummary - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_AnalyzerSummary.html): API data structure containing IAM Access Analyzer metadata and config
- [JobDetails - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_JobDetails.html): API data type containing policy generation job status and details
- [PolicyGeneration - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_PolicyGeneration.html): API data structure for policy generation status and properties
- [AccessPreview - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_AccessPreview.html): API data structure for IAM Access Analyzer access preview configuration
- [UnusedAccessConfiguration - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_UnusedAccessConfiguration.html): API data type for unused access analyzer configuration and rules

## Resource Configuration Types

- [S3BucketConfiguration - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_S3BucketConfiguration.html): API type for proposing S3 bucket policy, ACL, and access point config
- [IamRoleConfiguration - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_IamRoleConfiguration.html): API type for proposing IAM role trust policy configuration
- [DynamodbTableConfiguration - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_DynamodbTableConfiguration.html): API type for proposing DynamoDB table/index access control configuration
- [EbsSnapshotConfiguration - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_EbsSnapshotConfiguration.html): API type for proposing EBS snapshot access control with KMS encryption
- [SnsTopicConfiguration - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_SnsTopicConfiguration.html): API type for proposing SNS topic policy access control configuration

## Data Structures and Types

- [AclGrantee - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_AclGrantee.html): API union type for specifying S3 ACL grantee in Access Analyzer
- [Location - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_Location.html): API data structure for policy JSON path location and span
- [PathElement - IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/access-analyzer/latest/APIReference/API_PathElement.html): API union type representing single element in policy JSON path
